scenes.title: Level 12: Hero
scenes.subtitle: Blues and beyond
lines: This is Level 12: Hero — the final step in your journey.
You'll master the 12-bar blues, play Red River Valley, and graduate with barre chords, rhythm, and smooth changes.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll play the 12-bar blues progression, perform Red River Valley with confidence, and use barre chords to move between keys.
You'll have everything you need to jam with others or write your own music.

scenes.heading: Songs you'll play
lines: This level includes two songs: 12-Bar Blues in A and Red River Valley, both great for building confidence and style.
Pick up your guitar — we're starting with the 12-bar blues, the heartbeat of rock, soul and everything in between.
